reviewer_statement: A provisional developer-reviewed native R scientific plotting contract on a genuine simulated functional result. Numeric source artists have pinned Python 1.2 comparisons in committed tests, but successful exact-head CI has not yet been observed, and native R cannot return Matplotlib Axes or provide runtime class parity. This is not independent full-domain certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R scientific geometry is source-aligned on accepted simulated truth and original observations. Source plot semantics for numeric zero-based indices, finite scatter masks, phase-warp line order and population variance are implemented in strict mode. Python plotting Axes identity, Matplotlib rendering bytes and exception classes are excluded.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_functional_simulation_phase_warps. Real native source phase-warp truth vs identity time map, exact retention of first n curves and opacity.

Native true etr_functional_simulation_result with observed truth grid, actual n-by-time phase_warps_on_truth_grid, source max_curves integer positive or NULL, finite alpha in (0,1]. Default retains first twenty source curves. Strict mode exposes source artist representation without Python Matplotlib Axes injection.

Native source artist first line x=truth_grid y=truth_grid, dashed 'identity warp'; subsequent original n=min(n_curves,max_curves) phase-warp lines on exactly retained truth grid, opacity alpha, source title/labels. Committed direct frozen Python 1.2 public phase plot line get_ydata comparisons using same native simulation arrays; existing source-differential geometry tests passed in earlier waves, but this exact-head CI not witnessed green.
Reject unsupported class, zero/negative/noninteger max_curves, invalid alpha and malformed source truth/warps. No Python plotting ax injection and Python error type identity are claimed.

Source one-panel Matplotlib Axes with identity labelled dashed line and n phase lines, axes/title and identity legend. Native R base plot draws these curves and strict mode emits ordered, inspectable source scientific artist data, source options, and explicit matplotlib_object_identity=FALSE.

Visualize functional phase variation in realized simulated individual curves relative to the identity observation-to-latent time map, without retiming or warping any observations beyond truth already generated.

independent_review_status: Provisional scoped native scientific geometry author review; exact-head differential CI queued/unverified, independent certification zero.
language_specific_limits: R base plotting does not implement Python Matplotlib Axes or Figure return type, external ax parameter or pixel-equivalent rendering.
Strict result is a genuine native R simulated object with source artist data, not a Python FunctionalSimulationResult dataclass instance.
Python and R exceptions, plot legend backend state and Matplotlib figure event machinery remain different.
New tests have not been observed executing green, and no independent source-contract approval, main-branch merge or CRAN qualification is claimed.
